facts.fact: The rink dates are October 28 2026 to February 28 2027, not necessarily the dates of Holiday Shops.
Rink admission is free; rentals cost extra and own-skate users must reserve a time.
facts.excerpt: If you own your own skates, you can ice skate for free. Please be sure to reserve an entry time
